sentences.text: As the night wore on, the house's sensors noted something unusual in the kitchen, starting at 05:20.
It registered a peculiar warmth with no source, hinting at a friendly, unseen presence.
The observed temperature soared to 23.6 °C, a little warmer than the expected 22.8 °C.
This spectral heat peaked around 05:50, far outside the expected range of 22.6 °C to 23.0 °C.
Finally, the kitchen settled back down at 06:00, leaving only the memory of that sweet, ghostly warmth.
